title: AI-Powered Employee Handbook Builder and HR Compliance Tools

Employee Handbook Builder and HR Compliance Tools

Creating and maintaining compliant HR policies can be time-consuming as employment laws continue to evolve. In this video, learn how the Paychex HR Library and Employee Handbook Builder help businesses create, customize, and manage employee handbooks and workplace policy management with AI-powered tools. Discover how employers can access HR templates, monitor employment law updates by state, review legal changes through interactive compliance tools, and get AI-driven HR guidance in plain language, simplifying HR administration while reducing compliance risk.

Topics:

  • 0:00 – AI-Powered Compliance Tools Overview
  • 0:13 – Customizing Company Handbooks and Templates
  • 0:57 – Tracking Legal and Employment Updates
  • 1:16 – Compliance Calendar and Interactive Maps
  • 1:44 – AI-Driven HR Guidance Insights

<p id="transcript-button">View Transcript</p>

AI Powered Compliance Tools Overview

0:01 HR compliance tools are found right from your dashboard, from simplifying handbook creation to exploring an AI-powered tool to craft clear, consistent company guidelines.

Customizing Company Handbooks and Templates

0:14 Now that we're in the HR Library, let's make it yours. And what I mean by that is easily tailoring documents to fit your organization's policies.

0:24 Take the company handbook for example.

0:27 You can build, adjust, rewrite, or expand on the material to fine tune the details.

0:34 Or perhaps we are creating something new. Let's browse curated HR templates to not only help you support compliance but also set the standard.

0:45 With templates by the category, you're able to define clear policies with custom handbooks or effectively protect your business with documents to help you handle employee separation.

Tracking Legal and Employment Updates

0:58 Now that we've done the work to set the company standard, let's make sure we're aware of legal and employment updates as they happen.

1:07 Specify your search with available filters and even narrow it down by state, topic, or date to see the impact to your policies.

Compliance Calendar and Interactive Maps

1:17 Alrighty. Let's change things up. Maybe you'd prefer to digest these updates with a visual. Dive into a compliance calendar view to track changes day-by-day, review past and approaching legal updates at-a-glance, and all in one place.

1:35 You can even use interactive maps to research content on topics of your choosing to stay aligned with those requirements.

AI Driven HR Guidance Insights

1:45 Let's now save time with AI-driven insights from an extensive database.

1:50 No matter the question, simply state it in your own words, and you'll receive the HR guidance you need in plain language, no jargon.

2:01 Navigate regulatory uncertainty and remove the guesswork from compliance with the AI powered HR Library and Handbook Builder.

Build Better Employee Handbooks With Confidence

Create employee handbooks, customize workplace policies, monitor legal updates, and access AI-powered HR guidance from one centralized compliance platform.

Explore Employee Handbook Builder
